messages:
Ana (Design): Quick design sync — proposing a simpler error surface for our console forms. Idea: inline single-line error under the field for live validation, plus a collapsed 'Issues' summary that appears only on submit if there are >1 errors. Thoughts? Mike (Web): I like minimizing noise while typing. Concern: users might miss required fields that are empty until submit. How do we signal required fields pre-interaction? Ana (Design): Proposal: a subtle required marker (thin asterisk) + accessible label text for screen readers. No big red dots by default. If a field is focused and invalid, show inline error immediately. Sophia (Frontend): From an implementation POV we should use aria-invalid and aria-describedby. Example:```html \n
Enter a valid email
``` This triggers SR announce when error appears. Jules (a11y): Two accessibility nits: 1) use aria-live=\"polite\" on the summary region so we don't interrupt typing. 2) Required markers must also be programmatically determinable (aria-required). Also make sure color isn't the only cue. Kevin (PM): On destructive actions (delete dataset / purge cache) — are we standardizing on typed-confirm vs modal checkbox? We get repeated mistakes from support logs. Ana (Design): Leaning toward typed-confirm for high-risk deletes (\"type DELETE to confirm\") and a clear single-step modal with checkbox for medium risk. Typed confirms are slower but reduce accidents. Mike (Web): Agreed. For typed confirm we should still prefill focus into the input and prevent paste via JS to avoid accidental autofill. Also capture an analytics event on confirm. Sophia (Frontend): Suggested modal copy for medium risk:``` Title: Permanently delete this model? Body: This action cannot be undone. Type the model name to confirm or check \"I understand\" to proceed. Primary: Delete (destructive) Secondary: Cancel ``` Keep the primary button disabled until the condition is met. Jules (a11y): For typed confirms ensure label and instructions are read by SR on open; trap focus; on successful confirm move focus to a toast that explains outcome. Avoid relying purely on color for the disabled state. Kevin (PM): Can we add an experiment flag? roll it to 10% accounts for a week and measure accidental delete rate + task completion time. Ana (Design): Yes — I'll add UX mockups and copy variants for A/B: (A) inline errors + collapsed summary, (B) persistent top summary + inline. Also two delete flows: typed vs checkbox. Will post mocks later today. deploy-bot: Deployed staging build to env:feature/forms-feedback at 1716001400 :white_check_mark: Mike (Web): Quick note — small microcopy tweak: change \"required\" tooltip to \"This field is required to save\" instead of just \"required\". Clarity helps support. Ana (Design): Good call, Mike. I'll update copy and include Jules's a11y checklist. Thanks team — will follow up with mock links and a short hallway playtest sheet. :thumbsup:
